run_multinode_training: run multinode MCC training on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_training_job: submit a distributed training job to the SLURM scheduler via submitit AutoExecutor
parse_args: parse command line arguments for multinode training including ngpus, nodes, timeout, and partition
get_shared_folder: get or create a shared experiment folder under /checkpoint for the current user
Trainer_checkpoint: create a DelayedSubmission checkpoint from the latest checkpoint file for job resumption
